responsibility: Implements the Resolver2_0 helper used to materialize names exported by a module for glob imports. This file defines GlobbingVisitor’s concrete AST visits for public modules, macro_rules definitions, functions, statics, structs, tuple structs, enums, unions, and constants, inserting each visible item into the NameResolutionContext as a globbed binding in the appropriate value, type, or macro namespace so TopLevel use::* handling can re-export module contents with the correct shadowable import semantics.
same_name_distinction: Implements the GlobbingVisitor methods declared in the paired header, with the concrete per-AST-item logic that inserts public module contents into the appropriate value, type, or macro namespace during glob-import finalization.
